subject: Implement approval DBOS workflow
description:
Build `capo/workflows/approval.py` — DBOS workflow: insert `approvals` row with `status='pending'` → call `amc_client.send` with the approval question (envelope per §5.8 outbound shape) → await `DBOS.recv(approval_id, timeout=approval.timeout_seconds)` → on response, resolve the row to `approved`/`denied`; on timeout, resolve to `expired` and notify user.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

_Functional:_
- [ ] Workflow accepts `(action_kind, action_payload, user_id, thread_id)` and returns the `choice` (`approved`/`denied`) or raises `ApprovalExpired`.
- [ ] Inserts `approvals` row first, sends AMC question second, then awaits `DBOS.recv(approval_id)`.
- [ ] Outbound approval envelope shape per §5.8: `{ approval_id: str, prompt: str, options: list[str] }` (forwarded as the `approval` field on `POST /messages/send`).
- [ ] Timeout default: 30 minutes (`approval.timeout_seconds`); on timeout, status → `expired`, action aborted, user notified.
- [ ] Step uses the idempotency framework so workflow restart never resends the question or re-resolves a row.

_Edge Cases:_
- [ ] Workflow restart after `amc.send` but before `DBOS.recv` completes: idempotency prevents resending.
- [ ] User replies twice for the same `approval_id`: only the first reply resolves the row; subsequent are logged and ignored.
- [ ] Approval round-trip latency exceeds timeout: status `expired`, action aborted, user notified (per §13 risk).

_Error Handling:_
- [ ] AMC `CHANNEL_NOT_FOUND` while sending question: row marked `expired` immediately with reason; no retry.

**Testing Requirements:**
• Integration: full approve flow → workflow returns `approved`
• Integration: full deny flow → workflow returns `denied`
• Integration: timeout flow → workflow raises `ApprovalExpired` and AMC notification recorded
• Integration: restart between send and recv → exactly one approval question sent

Source: internal/specs/capo-SPEC.md Sections 5.8, 9.4
